harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established and restart-verified an AIDE integrity baseline for all of /etc on node1. The existing RHEL 10.0 release and kernel were preserved.
actions_performed: Installed vendor-supported AIDE 0.19.2 from Red Hat AppStream.
Configured `/etc EVERYTHING` with cryptographic hashes and metadata.
Created a root-only, SELinux-labeled baseline containing 1,448 entries.
Proved detection by adding a temporary file; AIDE reported it, then the probe was removed.
Restarted node1 safely, confirmed its boot ID changed, reviewed expected boot-time changes, refreshed the baseline, and obtained a clean final check.
Preserved the original vendor configuration at `/root/aide.conf.vendor-original` with mode 0600; removed all temporary artifacts.

evidence.requirement: Use compatible software while preserving the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged; Red Hat AIDE 0.19.2 was installed from AppStream.
The validated `/etc EVERYTHING` scope produced a protected 1,448-entry database; the final comparison reports no differences.

evidence.requirement: Identify and report later changes under /etc
evidence.summary: A temporary file was explicitly reported as one added entry under /etc.

evidence.requirement: Leave secured persistent artifacts and no temporary residue
evidence.summary: Configuration, database, and rollback copy are root-owned mode 0600 with appropriate SELinux labels; all test and temporary artifacts are absent.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Before restart, boot ID was 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d with a clean AIDE check and zero failed units. The reboot was acknowledged; afterward boot ID was 7b88d347-75cc-4b7a-aa8a-db380c2f5560. Final state is running with zero failed units, persistent protected data, and a clean AIDE check.

attempts.summary: Established and restart-verified an AIDE integrity baseline for all of /etc on node1. The existing RHEL 10.0 release and kernel were preserved.
